project_info.theme: Modern event portrait in an elegant emerald silk wrap dress
project_info.color_palette: emerald green, neutral architecture, daylight blue, delicate gold and warm skin tones

main_subject.detail: Clearly adult woman with long light-brown hair in a sleek high ponytail and a few soft face-framing strands, wearing an elegant emerald-green satin or silk midi wrap dress with a deep V wrap front, softly puffed sleeves, matching tie belt, gathered skirt and asymmetrical high slit. She wears delicate gold strappy heeled sandals and minimal elegant jewelry, with natural glowing makeup and a soft confident expression.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic editorial fashion portrait of a clearly adult woman with long light-brown hair styled in a sleek high ponytail, with a few soft strands gently framing her face. She wears an elegant emerald-green midi dress crafted from luxurious satin or silk that catches daylight with a subtle luminous sheen. The dress features a deep V-neck wrap front, short softly puffed sleeves, a matching tie belt defining the waist, a flowy gathered skirt below the knees and an asymmetrical high slit on one side that reveals a glimpse of her leg while remaining tasteful and fashion-editorial. She stands gracefully outside a sleek modern building with clean architectural lines and glass panels reflecting daylight, creating a sophisticated fashion-event atmosphere. She wears delicate gold strappy heeled sandals and minimal elegant jewelry. Her makeup is natural and glowing with soft foundation, subtle contour, lightly flushed cheeks, neutral eyeshadow, defined lashes and a muted rose lip color. Her expression is soft yet confident, poised and effortlessly stylish. Use natural daylight illumination, cinematic depth, editorial fashion photography, an 85mm lens look, shallow depth of field, high resolution, crisp fabric texture, subtle folds, natural body proportions and balanced composition. Keep background attendees and signage soft and non-identifying. Preserve the source dress, silhouette, slit, architecture and event mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted background faces, readable fake logos
